CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[DeriveIntersectTypeName] ( @id int ) RETURNS nvarchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @result nvarchar(500)
SET @result = ( SELECT COALESCE(SATT.Name,'') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE(OATT.Name, '') FROM [IntersectType] I left join AssetType SATT on I.Subject = SATT.[Object] and SATT.ObjectID = I.SubjectID and I.Subject != 'FusionAttributeType' left join AssetType OATT on I.Object = OATT.[Object] and OATT.ObjectID = I.ObjectID and I.Object != 'FusionAttributeType' left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID WHERE I.ID = @id )
RETURN @result END
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[DeriveIntersectTypeName] (
@id int
) RETURNS nvarchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @result nvarchar(500)
SET @result = ( SELECT COALESCE(SATT.Name, SF.TextPath,'') + ' [' + coalesce(P.Name,'/') + '] ' + COALESCE(OATT.Name, [OF].TextPath, '') FROM [IntersectType] I left join AssetType SATT on I.Subject = SATT.[Object] and SATT.ObjectID = I.SubjectID and I.Subject != 'FusionAttributeType' left join AssetType OATT on I.Object = OATT.[Object] and OATT.ObjectID = I.ObjectID and I.Object != 'FusionAttributeType'
left join [FusionAttributeType] SF on I.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' and SF.ID = I.SubjectID left join [FusionAttributeType] [OF] on I.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' and [OF].ID = I.ObjectID
left join [Predicate] P on P.ID = I.PredicateID WHERE I.ID = @id )
RETURN @result END
